draft: US federal fiscal position sources. Verified by download on 2026-10-26. All entries are implemented in pipeline/us/fiscal.py (groups 'fiscal' and 'forecast').

sources.format: JSON API (no key); amounts are strings in dollars and cents; paginate with page[size] (max 10000) and page[number]; meta.total-count checked against rows received
sources.publicationDate: 2026-10-23 (Fiscal Data 'last_updated' for mts_table_1; the statement itself is released on the eighth business day after month end)
sources.frequency: monthly; next release 2026-11-12 per the Fiscal Data release calendar (datasetId 015-BFS-2014Q1-13)
sources.history: API statements from record_date 2015-03-31. Table 1 in each statement repeats every month of the current and prior fiscal year, so totals exist from October 2013; Table 9 (current month, current FYTD, prior FYTD) gives complete detail from October 2014 (FY2015) using FY2016 prior-year columns. Output starts 2014-10.
sources.unit: USD (dollars and cents); output USD million rounded to $1,000
sources.basis: Cash; unified budget (on-budget plus off-budget); not seasonally adjusted; fiscal year October-September
sources.scope: US federal government; excludes state and local governments
sources.revisions: Table 1 restates months of the current and prior fiscal year in every statement; 101 of 156 months differ between first and last publication, mostly by under $100m but up to $16.7bn (outlays, September 2024). Table 9 prior-FYTD differences reconcile with the newest Table 1 values within $1.7bn (largest: November 2015 outlays). Table 9 current-month values equal Table 1 as first published to the dollar.

tables.mts_table_1: Summary of Receipts, Outlays, and the Deficit/Surplus. Rows: 'FY YYYY' header (parent_id null), month rows (record_type_cd MTH, classification_desc = month name, parent = FY header) and 'Year-to-Date' total. Columns current_month_gross_rcpt_amt, current_month_gross_outly_amt, current_month_dfct_sur_amt (positive = deficit). Despite the 'gross' field names these are net budget receipts and outlays and equal Table 9 totals.
tables.mts_table_9: Summary of Receipts by Source, and Outlays by Function. Sections 'Receipts' and 'Net Outlays' (sequence_level_nbr 1); detail rows data_type_cd D; totals T; 'Social Insurance and Retirement Receipts:' is a valueless subheading over three lines. Columns current_month_rcpt_outly_amt, current_fytd_rcpt_outly_amt, prior_fytd_rcpt_outly_amt.
tables.mts_table_4: Receipts by source in more detail (withheld vs non-withheld individual taxes, refunds). Not used: Table 9 already gives an exhaustive source split.
tables.mts_table_5: Outlays by agency. Not used: functions (Table 9) map better to Social Security, Medicare, defense and net interest.

series.payrollTaxes: Table 9 Employment and General Retirement + Unemployment Insurance + Other Retirement
series.netInterest: Table 9 Net Interest (function 900); can be negative in some Septembers
series.otherOutlays: Table 9 total net outlays less the seven named functions (derived; includes undistributed offsetting receipts)

validation: Every Table 1 row: outlays - receipts = deficit within $100; month rows sum to the Year-to-Date row within $1,000 for each fiscal year in each statement.
Every Table 9 statement: receipt lines are exactly the nine known lines and outlay lines a subset of the 19 budget functions; lines sum to the section totals within $1,000.
Table 9 totals equal Table 1 first-published values to $10,000 (same statement) and newest Table 1 values within $2bn (revised path).
Output: contiguous months from October; identity spending - receipts = borrowing within $0.01m; receipt and outlay detail sum to totals; plausible USD million magnitudes.

sources.format: JSON API; one row per security class plus 'Total Marketable', 'Total Nonmarketable' and 'Total Public Debt Outstanding' (security_class_desc '_'); USD million
sources.frequency: monthly, month-end (record_date is the calendar month end)
sources.scope: Treasury securities; debt held by the public excludes intragovernmental holdings (trust funds) and agency debt
sources.alternatives: Debt to the Penny (v2/accounting/od/debt_to_penny, debt_held_public_amt) gives the same month-end total to the dollar (checked for 2026-09-30) but is daily; MSPD is the official month-end statement and was preferred.
validation: Total Marketable + Total Nonmarketable = Total Public Debt Outstanding within $3m (lines are rounded independently, differences up to $2m observed).
0 < debt held by the public <= gross debt.

sources.format: CSV 'observation_date,NA000334Q'; quarter start dates (YYYY-01-01 etc.); no metadata or release date
sources.unit: USD million, quarterly level, not seasonally adjusted (checked: four NSA quarters match the annual average of SAAR GDP in $ billion x 1000 within 1%)

licence.name: Public domain (BEA, U.S. Government work); FRED terms of use apply to the download

sources.access: Works with the dashboard's plain requests User-Agent. curl with HTTP/2 had its stream reset; no browser user agent was used.

sources.format: CSV long format date (YYYYqN), variable, value, estimate_type; variable 'gdp' is nominal GDP, SAAR, $ billion
sources.latestVintage: 2026-02 (The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2026 to 2036); vintage chosen as the newest 'quarterly' file listed in catalog.json
sources.use: GDP publication gap only: a quarter BEA has not yet published (at most two) = BEA NSA value a year earlier x CBO gdp(q) / CBO gdp(q-4). Rows are flagged with forecastQuarters and disclosed in gdp.forecastExtension.
sources.limitations: cbo.gov returns 403 to automated requests, so the exact publication day is unavailable; publicationDate is the vintage month. The repository may lag cbo.gov.
sources.implementedBy: pipeline/us/fiscal.py cbo_vintage, parse_cbo_gdp (growth applied with pipeline.obr_gdp.forecast_quarters)

sources.use: forecast group: names the latest CBO baseline vintage only. CBO and OMB publish annual fiscal-year projections, not a monthly profile, so forecast.json has status 'unavailable' and no cumulative path.
